title_en: The New Friend in the Village
moral_en: Being kind to new friends makes everyone happy.
moral_ta: புதிய நண்பர்களிடம் அன்பாக இருந்தால் எல்லோரும் மகிழ்ச்சியாக இருப்பார்கள்.
description_en: Arjun moves to a new village and feels shy, but Kavya's kindness helps him make a new friend.
description_ta: அர்ஜுன் புதிய கிராமத்திற்கு வந்து வெட்கப்படுகிறான், ஆனால் கவ்யாவின் அன்பு அவனுக்கு புதிய நண்பனை உருவாக்க உதவுகிறது.
character_sheet: Arjun: 5-year-old boy, short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts. Kavya: 5-year-old girl, long black hair in two braids, wearing a pink dress with small white flowers.

scenes.image_prompt: A 5-year-old boy named Arjun with short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts, looking out of a window of a small house with a sad/shy expression, seeing a group of children playing outside in a sunny village street, soft 2D watercolor storybook style, bright warm colors, vertical 9:16 portrait composition, 1080x1920, no text.
scenes.text_en: Arjun and his family moved to a new village. He looked out the window and saw children playing happily. Arjun felt shy and stayed inside.
scenes.text_ta: அர்ஜுனும் அவனது குடும்பமும் புதிய கிராமத்திற்கு குடிவந்தனர். அவன் ஜன்னல் வழியாக வெளியே பார்த்தான், குழந்தைகள் மகிழ்ச்சியாக விளையாடுவதைக் கண்டான். அர்ஜுன் வெட்கப்பட்டு உள்ளேயே இருந்தான்.

scenes.image_prompt: A 5-year-old girl named Kavya with long black hair in two braids, wearing a pink dress with small white flowers, standing outside a house, smiling and waving at a 5-year-old boy named Arjun with short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts, who is at the window, shyly waving back, village background, soft 2D watercolor storybook style, bright warm colors, vertical 9:16 portrait, 1080x1920, no text.
scenes.text_en: A little girl named Kavya saw Arjun at the window. She smiled and waved at him. Arjun shyly waved back.
scenes.text_ta: கவ்யா என்ற சிறுமி ஜன்னலில் அர்ஜுனைப் பார்த்தாள். அவள் புன்னகைத்து அவனுக்கு கை அசைத்தாள். அர்ஜுன் வெட்கத்துடன் திரும்பி கை அசைத்தான்.

scenes.image_prompt: A 5-year-old girl named Kavya with long black hair in two braids, wearing a pink dress with small white flowers, holding a red ball, standing near the door of a house, inviting a 5-year-old boy named Arjun with short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts, who is smiling and stepping outside, village setting, soft 2D watercolor storybook style, bright warm colors, vertical 9:16 portrait, 1080x1920, no text.
scenes.text_en: Kavya came closer with a red ball. She asked Arjun to come out and play. Arjun smiled and went outside.
scenes.text_ta: கவ்யா ஒரு சிவப்பு பந்துடன் அருகில் வந்தாள். அவள் அர்ஜுனை வெளியே வந்து விளையாட அழைத்தாள். அர்ஜுன் புன்னகைத்து வெளியே சென்றான்.

scenes.image_prompt: A 5-year-old boy named Arjun with short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts, and a 5-year-old girl named Kavya with long black hair in two braids, wearing a pink dress with small white flowers, playing with a red ball in a sunny village yard, both laughing and running, soft 2D watercolor storybook style, bright warm colors, vertical 9:16 portrait, 1080x1920, no text.
scenes.text_en: Arjun and Kavya played with the ball. They laughed and ran around. Arjun felt happy.
scenes.text_ta: அர்ஜுனும் கவ்யாவும் பந்துடன் விளையாடினர். அவர்கள் சிரித்து ஓடினர். அர்ஜுன் மகிழ்ச்சியாக உணர்ந்தான்.

scenes.image_prompt: A 5-year-old boy named Arjun with short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts, and a 5-year-old girl named Kavya with long black hair in two braids, wearing a pink dress with small white flowers, sitting together on a bench under a tree, smiling and talking, village background, soft 2D watercolor storybook style, bright warm colors, vertical 9:16 portrait, 1080x1920, no text.
scenes.text_en: Arjun and Kavya became best friends. They played together every day. Arjun was no longer shy.
scenes.text_ta: அர்ஜுனும் கவ்யாவும் சிறந்த நண்பர்கள் ஆனார்கள். அவர்கள் ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் ஒன்றாக விளையாடினர். அர்ஜுன் இனி வெட்கப்படவில்லை.

scenes.image_prompt: A 5-year-old boy named Arjun with short black hair, wearing a yellow kurta and blue shorts, and a 5-year-old girl named Kavya with long black hair in two braids, wearing a pink dress with small white flowers, hugging each other warmly, both smiling, village background, soft 2D watercolor storybook style, bright warm colors, vertical 9:16 portrait, 1080x1920, no text.
scenes.text_en: Arjun thanked Kavya for being kind. Kavya smiled and gave him a hug. They both felt warm and happy.
scenes.text_ta: அர்ஜுன் கவ்யாவுக்கு அன்பாக இருந்ததற்காக நன்றி சொன்னான். கவ்யா புன்னகைத்து அவனைக் கட்டிப்பிடித்தாள். இருவரும் சூடாகவும் மகிழ்ச்சியாகவும் உணர்ந்தனர்.
